en.action.recallConfirmDesc: This message and everything after it continue from here; the original content can be brought back later with “Restore display” on this marker.
en.action.recallPauseFailed: Could not pause the current run; recall continued
en.action.recallPauseTimeout: Timed out waiting for the run to pause; recall continued
en.action.reopenBlocked: This message and everything after it is too large a range to restart (refused by the guard). If you only meant to change this text, use the fallback:
en.action.sendFromHereHint: Resending restarts from here: this message and everything after it will be replaced/hidden and continue on a new timeline branch. Large ranges are refused by the guard — then the error offers “Change this text only (keep what follows)”.
en.action.sendOnlyThis: Change this text only (keep what follows)
en.action.sendOnlyThisHint: Replace only this message and its reply; the conversation after it stays as is (no new timeline branch).
en.badge.hint: A stable lineage ID derived from the session id (titles change, badges never do).
en.error.busy: Stop the current reply before recalling or editing
en.error.messageNotFound: That message is not in the session log (deleted, or the id is invalid)
en.error.messagePending: Message is still being generated; edit it once it finishes
en.error.rollbackGuide: This rewrite spans too much (large sessions cannot be rewritten in place): this message and everything after it cannot be replaced together. Use “Change this text only (keep what follows)” below, or start a new session to restart.
en.error.spanReplayFailed: Could not compute the shadow range (internal error): session-log replay failed; retry or report this session
en.error.targetShadowed: This message is inside a folded (read-only) history block: expand that block to edit it, or append a new message instead
en.error.unshadowHeld: The session file is held by another process: close the process holding it and retry.
en.error.unshadowLsof: Cannot verify whether the session file is in use (lsof unavailable): refusing to proceed.
en.error.unshadowReshadowed: That range is shadowed again by a later marker: true-restore the later marker first, then this one.
en.error.unshadowRunning: This session has an in-flight turn: stop the current reply (stop button / wait for it to settle), then retry.
en.error.unshadowUnavailable: This host did not wire the true-restore capability (the host must inject the log-surgery surface).
en.host.replacements: {count} host-side surface replacements (not changes made by this plugin) are excluded from the list.
en.marker.degradedHint: This operation spans a large part of the conversation; content stays visible to protect your history (the log is intact).
en.marker.edit: Resent (this message and everything after it restarted); the conversation continues from the new message
en.marker.recall: This message and the following conversation were recalled
en.marker.referenceHint: Click to expand the original input (reference only, never sent to the model)
en.marker.t1Broken: Edit applied; this marker will break /compact for this session. Offline clean-up: close the session and run dsh-log-contract fix --drop-turnnull (the edit reverts to the original content).
en.marker.trueRestore: Truly restored: the recalled content is back in the model context (log neutralized in place, seq unchanged)
en.marker.trueRestoreHint: Put the recalled content back on the MODEL surface (rewrites those two marker lines into a no-effect shape): afterwards the range is editable/recallable/resendable again. Works from inside this session (the button lives here); only an in-flight turn is refused. The session view reloads right away; if it still shows the old view, reload the page (or reopen the session) as the last resort.
en.marker.trueRestoreReload: The log was rewritten: a re-read signal was pushed, this session view reloads right away and the restored content is visible again (the model surface is restored). If the view still shows the old one, reload the page (or reopen the session).
en.marker.unhide: Display restored for the recalled content (model context and the recall trace are unchanged)
en.marker.unhideHint: Show the content this marker hides again (display only: the log is append-only and the model context is unchanged)
en.marker.unionHint: About {count}% of the history is hidden in total; click "Restore display" on any marker row to bring recalled content back.
en.options.closeGuardDesc: Off (default): when enabled, confirm before the page closes — when sessions have running or unfinished work this plugin shows its own Chinese confirm dialog ([Cancel] / [Close anyway]), and [Close anyway] really exits (the dialog waits for your choice; Esc cancels); with no running work the page closes directly, without interruption. Desktop (DSH Desktop) never arms the host native dialog path (the desktop shell has no will-prevent-unload handler, so that dialog is swallowed silently); it uses the page-drawn confirm gate instead: draw the dialog and verify it is visible first, only then block the close; if it cannot be drawn or shown, or the page is not visible, the close passes immediately, with a watchdog (Web Worker timer, immune to background throttling) as the last resort. Arming the native gate takes both criteria: the host says a native dialog appears (quitVeto) AND this page shows no desktop evidence itself (no Electron in the UA, no dsh-desktop- in the URL) — if either fails it stays unarmed (a client-side veto). Quit entries differ by version/platform — the 0.9.0-class entry in the external report does reach page beforeunload, while the 2.0.9 tray/⌘Q goes requestQuit→window.destroy→app.exit and never reaches this gate. If Desktop cannot quit, turn this off first (recovers immediately, no restart).
en.options.gitDesc: On: uses git to record and roll back when the workspace is a repository (never auto-commits, never touches your branches); non-repo workspaces can enable git from the timeline. Off: built-in snapshots under the plugin data home only — the plugin never touches the workspace git state; equivalent features.
en.options.retentionDesc: File snapshots are kept for the most recent N checkpoints; older ones are pruned automatically (checkpoint records and the audit trail are always kept).
en.options.showOriginalInput: Show the original input after editing
en.options.summaryDesc: On: each recall/edit makes one small model call to summarize the discarded old content, to help you remember it; requires the host llm service and degrades to verbatim text only when absent. Off (default): verbatim text only, no calls.
en.options.title: Message editor plugin
en.options.versioningDesc: On: every recall/edit saves a checkpoint (messages and touched files) powering the checkpoint list and artifact rollback. Off: only rewinds context — no checkpoints, no artifact tracking (lightest).
en.panel.error.actions: Message action strip failed to render
en.panel.error.marker: Edit / recall marker failed to render
en.panel.error.userActions: User message actions failed to render
en.path.title: Current path
en.timeline.artifactsImpact: Will change or delete {count} files (listed below)
en.timeline.artifactsOnlyDesc: Restore the files this checkpoint touched to their state back then
en.timeline.bothDesc: Roll back the context first, then the artifacts
en.timeline.collapseHintTitle: Collapse this entry (no need to scroll to the bottom)
en.timeline.contextOnlyDesc: Remove messages after this checkpoint (the log audit trail stays)
en.timeline.doctorWarn: This session has {count} edit/recall markers; clean them before compacting (/compact) or compaction may fail.
en.timeline.empty: No checkpoints yet. A recall / edit / regenerate saves one here.
en.timeline.gitInitDesc: Runs git init in the workspace (adds a minimal .gitignore and a baseline commit); rollback will prefer git.
en.timeline.intro: Every recall / edit / regenerate saves what it replaced. {count} changes in this session — click one to expand.
en.timeline.jumpFailed: This checkpoint lies too far back (beyond the auto-load budget) to locate directly. Scroll up to load earlier messages, or use Details to read its original event text.
en.timeline.noChanges: Already at this checkpoint; nothing to change
en.timeline.orderHint: newest changes are at the bottom
en.timeline.previewDesc: Returns to the checkpoint taken at "{kind}" ({version}).
en.timeline.title: Checkpoints
en.timeline.why.compaction: Earlier context was compacted at this point.
en.timeline.why.edit: This message was rewritten and resent; the original wording is kept for comparison.
en.timeline.why.recall: Everything after this point is dropped; the conversation continues from here.
en.timeline.why.regenerate: This reply was regenerated; the previous reply leaves the conversation.
en.timeline.why.replace: A replacement happened here; the old content leaves the conversation.
en.timeline.why.restore: The conversation returns to its state at this checkpoint.
en.view.errorHint: This panel could not render (the rest of the app is unaffected). Use Retry to render it again.
en.what.compacted: the host compacted this context (not caused by this rewind) — originals are no longer in the log
en.what.noNewMissing: the counterpart for this entry is no longer in the log
en.what.noNewRecall: no new counterpart — later input follows this recall
